messages:
maria: Quick alignment thread 1: we need a razor pass on three landing pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private) before the webinar opens. Goals: clarify conversion paths, include one short benchmark per mode, clear webinar CTA, and map inbound form routing. Keep copy scannable.
jon: Heard. For benchmarks do we want absolute numbers or relative comparisons?
kevin: Absolute but simple: Hosted -> latency + common token cost; Dedicated -> throughput + autoscale note; Private -> compliance, auditability. Avoid micro-decimals, use round numbers.
nashley: Draft headline options (short): 1) "Production-grade LLM inference, your way." 2) "Same API. Any deployment. Production SLAs." Which reads stronger?
maria: Lean to 2 but tweak: "One API. Any deployment. Production SLAs." Short and punchy.
jon: Webinar CTA copy: "Register: Live demo + benchmarks for Hosted, Dedicated, Private". Place as primary CTA on each page, secondary CTA = "Request demo" for enterprise leads.
kevin: Inbound form routing logic suggestion (ops-friendly pseudocode):
```
form_submit:
  if company_size == "enterprise" or budget_estimate >= 50k:
    route_to: sdr-enterprise@redwood.ai
    tag: "prio-enterprise"
  elif wants_dedicated == true:
    route_to: solutions@redwood.ai
  else:
    route_to: selfserve@redwood.ai
  if request_webinar == true:
    add_to_campaign: "webinar-launch-apr"
```
maria: Nice. Keep routing simple and document on Confluence. Also add a field: "primary_use_case" to help SDRs prioritize.
ashley: Hero micro-benchmark lines (one-liners under hero): Hosted: "~50 ms median token latency (small open LLM) and transparent $/1k tokens"; Dedicated: "Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput — e.g., 5k tokens/sec sustained"; Private: "Enterprise controls: SOC 2, customer-managed VPC, KMS & audit logs". Short, no parentheses.
jon: Benefit bullets: "Unified API across deployments", "Predictable costs & autoscaling", "Enterprise-grade controls". Keep voice active.
kevin: Also include a short "how it works" line: "Smart routing, caching, and kernel optimizations to balance latency and cost." One sentence.
maria: For the Private page add a tiny trust line: "Optional on-prem, audit-ready logs, and KMS integrations." Link to compliance pages.
ashley: I'll prepare two headline variants and three CTAs and drop them into the website copy doc. Will flag preferred variants by EOD.
marketing-bot: Heads-up: webinar registration form must be live by Tue 09:00 PT 1 — @ashley finalize CTAs by Mon 16:00.
kevin: I'll create a one-page benchmark PDF per mode with methodology notes and sample prompts. Will post links here.
maria: OK let's meet Mon 10:00 PT for final sign-off. If anything blocks, ping me in DMs. :rocket:
